evals.prompt: /crit my changes — added rate limiting to the login endpoint, 6 files in src/auth/ and src/api/
evals.expected_output: Runs simplify pre-pass, then dispatches 2 reviewers (Correctness & Security + Devil's Advocate) in one message. Consolidates with spot-checking and dedup.
expectations: Dispatches exactly 2 reviewer agents in a single message
Does NOT dispatch 5+ perspective agents — that's /superreview

evals.prompt: /crit -- bugfix for crash on launch. commit message is 'fix(startup): add regression tests'. diff is 3 test files, 0 production files
evals.expected_output: Bugfix scope validation catches test-only diff. Verdict FAIL with Critical finding.
expectations: Verdict FAIL — bugfix with no production changes

evals.expected_output: After review, auto-fixes Critical + High findings. Does NOT fix Medium or nitpicks.
expectations: --auto high means fix Critical and High severity only
Medium and nitpick findings are left in IGNORE
Single fix pass, no re-review loop

evals.expected_output: Skips simplify pre-pass (PR review). Uses gh pr diff 87. Still dispatches 2 reviewers.
expectations: Uses gh pr diff 87 for the diff

evals.prompt: /crit -- added a dedup filter checking originator_id to skip our own updates. 4 files in src/replication/
evals.expected_output: Devil's advocate catches the assumption issue: does originator_id mean last modifier or original creator?
expectations: At least one reviewer questions originator_id semantics
Flags potential data loss if originator_id is immutable
